overrides.name: hostName-lib.mkForce
overrides.rationale: audit-fact:candidate-evaluation — effective hostname remains s-router-prod after removing the lib.mkForce hostname override; removal is safe and approved by user audit facts

overrides.name: qemu-mkForce
overrides.rationale: audit-fact:candidate-evaluation — removal adds default user networking and duplicate vmbr4 NICs; retained conservatively

overrides.name: kea-legacy-lease-paths
overrides.rationale: audit-fact:candidate-evaluation — removal loses StateDirectory=kea and /var/lib/kea/<vlan>.leases semantics; retained per FS-860/FS-880 durable-state contracts

overrides.name: nebula-public-ingress-hotpatch
overrides.rationale: audit-fact:candidate-evaluation — removal loses all 4242 DNAT/SNAT/forward rules and required return routes; retained until parity assertions are constructed upstream

overrides.name: reservation-overrides-runtime-secret-bindings
overrides.rationale: audit-fact:candidate-evaluation — reservation overrides bind runtime secret material; retained as protected references, never copied in plaintext

overrides.name: vlan2-vlan3-return-hotpatch
overrides.rationale: audit-fact:candidate-evaluation — removal is blocked until the exact offline parity predicate for VLAN2->VLAN3 return traffic passes
